verdict.rationale: Render documents its own load-based autoscaling, which it says handles 100x traffic bursts, and a community user confirms autoscaling. That covers the 'scale under load' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses sub-second instance boot or scaling to tens of thousands of instances. Missing for 10: evidence of sub-second boot/cold-start times, documented instance-count ceilings reaching tens of thousands, independent hands-on corroboration of scaling behavior.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
they support distributed Elixir out of the box as well as autoscaling
